s.en: Compute unique ID for a patch

o.en: Calculate the patch ID of the input as it is given, do not strip any whitespace. Implies --stable and forbids --unstable. This is the default if patchid.verbatim is true.
Use a "stable" sum of hashes as the patch ID. With this option: • Reordering file diffs that make up a patch does not affect the ID.

Use an "unstable" hash as the patch ID. With this option, the result produced is compatible with the patch ID value produced by Git 1.9 and older and whitespace is ignored. Users with pre-existing databases storing patch IDs produced by Git 1.9 and older (who do not deal with reordered patches) may want to use this option.
